== Introduction ==

This is my eight year old brother's HB deck. Suggestions would be appreciated.

== Strategy ==

--- update (2/24) ---
Thanks for your help everyone! My brother played an X-wing version of this deck over the weekend. He went 0-2 but he had hard matchups. He faced a 1960 rated player with it in game 1 and lost by 14 to a 1760 player in game 4. Keep in mind my brother is rated 1590.

Since he's eight, he's not really supposed to post stuff online without a parent's consent. So here I am typing stuff up for him...

Obviously this deck needs alot of work. First off, you see most of the pilots don't have matching ships and vice-versa. He doesn't seem to listen to me, so maybe he'll listen to you guys.
